changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO public.tenant_memberships (id, user_id, tenant_key, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), u.id, 'platform', 'ACTIVE', TIMESTAMP '2026-05-28 10:00:00', TIMESTAMP '2026-05-28 10:00:00', 'system', 'system' FROM public.users u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_memberships tm WHERE tm.user_id = u.id AND tm.tenant_key = 'platform');

INSERT INTO public.tenant_member_authorities (id, membership_id, authority) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), tm.id, 'MEMBER' FROM public.tenant_memberships tm WHERE tm.tenant_key = 'platform' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_member_authorities tma WHERE tma.membership_id = tm.id);
